summary: Second-round regression test after major refactor (9 new sub-components, chartConfig constants, type hints, builder pattern seed, OCI scripts). 16/16 backend pytest pass (including new 422 validation for missing 'topic'). All 9 frontend routes (/, /revenue, /agents, /builds, /deployments, /content, /studio, /approvals, /audit) load with ZERO JS errors. Overview sub-components (MetricsCards, RevenueChart, ActivityFeed, StreamHealthTable) render correctly. Content Studio shows refactored cost compliance: 2 Free Connectors / 4 Manual Export / 1 Paid Blocked. Sidebar correctly shows Operations/Revenue/System sections with Build Registry and Approval Queue labels. CreateIdeaDialog opens with all data-testids intact. No regressions detected from refactoring.
critical_code_review_comments: Iteration 1's flag about POST /api/studio/ideas/ returning 500 on missing fields is now RESOLVED — ContentIdeaCreate Pydantic schema in routes/content_factory.py returns proper 422 with field 'topic' mentioned in detail.

Iteration 1's sidebar concern ('Revenue Intel' pointing to /builds) is RESOLVED — sidebar now shows clean labels: Operations (Command Center, Income Streams, AI Agents, Content Factory), Revenue (Content Library, Build Registry, Deployments, Approval Queue), System (Audit Log, LGAC Monitor).
routes/content_factory.py still imports db lazily via `from server import db` inside get_db dependency — works but app.state.db dependency would be cleaner. Non-blocking.
Multiple route handlers repeat the datetime-string→datetime hydration loop (~10 occurrences across routes). Could be extracted to a single helper. Non-blocking.
AI script generation completed in <2s during pytest — likely cached/fast Gemini path via Emergent LLM key. Confirmed working end-to-end.
